profile.headline: Software Engineer at JPMorgan Chase & Co.
profile.summary:
As a Software Engineer III at JPMorgan Chase, I develop cutting-edge user interfaces for the company's digital properties, using state-of-the-art libraries and frameworks like React. I collaborate seamlessly with cross-functional teams, including front and back-end developers, design professionals, business analysts, project management experts, and content production teams. I use provided wireframes and functional requirements to carefully interpret and implement design elements, and I implement optimizations to enhance website performance, focusing on achieving maximum speed and scalability. I also thoroughly assess code for robustness and continually optimize applications to enhance performance. 

I have a Bachelor of Science in Software Development from Western Governors University, and I have earned multiple certifications, such as Google IT Support Professional Certificate, CompTIA A+ ce Certification, and ITIL v4. I am passionate about creating clean, efficient, and innovative solutions, and I am committed to continuous learning and staying up to date with the latest technologies and methodologies. I thrive in collaborative environments, valuing open communication and the collective pursuit of success. I have a strong work ethic, a strong sense of responsibility, and a strong pursuit of improvement. I am excited about the opportunity to contribute my skills and enthusiasm to create impactful and scalable software solutions.

positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.description:
- Engineer cutting-edge user interfaces for J.P. Morgan's digital properties, leveraging advanced libraries and frameworks like React to deliver high-quality, innovative software solutions.

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including front-end and back-end developers, UX/UI designers, business analysts, project managers, and content production teams, while ensuring seamless integration and project success.

- Analyze and implement design elements based on provided wireframes and functional requirements, ensuring alignment with user experience and business objectives.

- Enhance website performance through targeted optimizations focused on achieving maximum speed, scalability, and responsiveness.

- Conduct rigorous code assessments for robustness and maintain a continuous optimization approach to improve application performance and reliability.

- Manage production tasks and deployments, ensuring timely delivery in accordance with project deadlines.

- Research and integrate the latest software development trends and tools to maintain modern, efficient, and innovative development practices.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
- Design and develop user-centric experiences, leveraging agile methodologies for continuous improvement and iteration.

- Engage in technical development, debugging, and delivery of sophisticated web applications, ensuring high-quality results.

- Conduct rigorous code testing to ensure robustness, consistently enhancing applications and optimizing performance.

- Collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams to define, design, and deliver innovative products and services.

positions.title: Billing Specialist
positions.description:
- Utilizing Excel for data organization and retrieval indicates strong skills in data handling, analysis, and software tools.

- Managing claims and verifying billing accuracy demonstrates precision and thoroughness, critical for software testing and debugging.

- Assisting with electronically adjudicated claims and ensuring timely reconciliations reflects an understanding of workflow optimization and efficiency.

- Resolving billing issues and managing claim audits showcase the ability to troubleshoot and develop solutions, which is essential in software development.

- Following Medicare billing requirements and company policies illustrates a commitment to quality control and adherence to established standards.

- Serving as a liaison between patients and billing teams demonstrates effective communication and collaboration skills, which are valuable in team-based software projects.

- Engaging with patients regarding billing inquiries and payment plans demonstrates empathy and problem-solving abilities, which are important for user-centric software development.
positions.insights: Skills: Data Entry · Invoicing · Quality Patient Care · Patient Education · Client Billing · Patient Advocacy · Patient Support · Insurance Billing · Microsoft Excel

positions.title: Financial Access Coordinator
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States · On-site
positions.description:
- Utilize advanced Excel and SQL skills to track patient information and hospital turnaround times, retrieving data from databases to present actionable management insights.

- Receive and process prescriptions, providing appropriate follow-up on rejected claims to ensure timely resolution and minimize delays.

- Complete third-party prior authorization requests and verify prescriptions, demonstrating attention to detail and accuracy in claims processing.

- Deliver high-quality customer service by assisting patients with applications for the Patient Assistance Program (PAP) and co-pay assistance, ensuring their needs are met effectively.

- Obtain and verify patients’ insurance benefit information from insurance companies and private payers, ensuring comprehensive coverage for services provided.

- Ensure accuracy and compliance by maintaining and completing all insurance assessment forms and agreements to facilitate efficient claims processing.
positions.insights: Skills: Clinical Pharmacy · Clinical Research · Microsoft Excel · Healthcare · Clinical Data Management · Data Entry · Medical Terminology · Medical Coding · Medical Billing · Quality Patient Care · U.S. Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) · Patient Safety · Patient Advocacy · Patient Support

positions.title: Program Coordinator
positions.locationName: New Hyde Park, New York, United States · On-site
positions.description:
- Receive and coordinate all program referrals, managing activities such as savings card activation to ensure seamless operations and patient support.

- Serve as the primary point of contact for phone inquiries from patients and physicians, demonstrating strong communication skills and customer service orientation.

- Identify and redirect non-clinical inquiries, applying discretion and independent judgment to enhance workflow efficiency and maintain focus on core responsibilities.

- Document and meticulously update patient profiles with relevant information regarding care and physician needs, showcasing attention to detail and strong data management skills.

- Address and resolve customer complaints with a problem-solving mindset, ensuring thorough documentation and forwarding to appropriate team members for resolution.

- Communicate effectively with department supervisors and program directors regarding program updates and challenges, fostering collaboration and transparency within the team.
positions.insights: Skills: Clinical Research · Healthcare · Patient Assessment · Medical Records · Medical Terminology · Health Insurance · Patient Satisfaction · Medical Coding · Patient Care · U.S. Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) · Case Management · Patient Support

positions.title: Operations Supervisor
positions.locationName: Queens, New York, United States · On-site
positions.description:
- Train and mentor associates in roles such as cashiers, photo specialists, shift leaders, and assistant managers, fostering a collaborative and skilled workforce.

- Organize and enhance report binders for inventory control and loss prevention, demonstrating strong organizational skills critical for managing documentation in software projects.

- Create weekly schedules aligned with hourly budgets and forecasted sales, utilizing analytical skills to optimize workforce efficiency and workflow.

- Conduct interviews and support onboarding processes, showcasing effective communication and interpersonal skills that are essential for team dynamics.

- Anticipate customer and store needs by evaluating the shop environment and consumer behavior, adopting a customer-centric mindset that is valuable in software development.

- Deliver exceptional customer service, documenting and forwarding inquiries to appropriate team members for resolution, reflecting strong problem-solving abilities.

- Supervise a team of twenty, managing all internal departments to oversee sales targets, stock levels, and the store environment, demonstrating leadership and project management skills.

- Monitor and exceed sales expectations while minimizing shrink percentages through daily cash reports, deliveries, and damage assessments, highlighting performance monitoring capabilities.

- Catalog and schedule daily deliveries to anticipate sales, showcasing an ability to manage logistics and operational efficiency.
positions.insights: Skills: Cash Management · Cash Handling · Operations Administration · Strategic Planning · Management · Daily Operations · Operations Management · Cash Flow · Communication

positions.title: Shift Supervisor
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States · On-site
positions.description:
- Manage orientations and onboarding programs, serving as the lead instructor to effectively train and integrate new sales team members into the organization.

- Create and maintain an efficient learning guide to enhance the training process and provide resources that facilitate skill development within the sales team.

- Monitor systems and operational issues to identify areas for improvement, demonstrating analytical skills and a commitment to optimizing workflows.

- Collect, analyze, and report financial information using Excel, showcasing strong data analysis capabilities and attention to detail in performance monitoring.

- Operate the cash room and verify that daily budgets are handled accurately, ensuring financial compliance and integrity.

- Deliver excellent customer service by assessing customer needs and making relevant merchandise suggestions, adopting a user-centric approach to enhance customer satisfaction.

- Conduct cash audits for cashiers to ensure that in-store cash collected matches the funds sent to the bank, highlighting a strong focus on accuracy and compliance.

- Perform various merchandising tasks, including shipment processing, markdowns, transfers, damages, and stock replenishment, demonstrating organizational skills and effective inventory management.
positions.insights: Skills: Cash Management · Cash Handling · Team Building · Customer Service · Event Management · Customer Retention · Management · Scheduling · Sales · Employee Training · Interviewing · Customer Engagement
